source.label: prop: lower_bd
source.quote: Assume an MO-MAB environment contains multiple objective-conflicting arms, i.e., $\vert \mathcal{O}^{*} \vert \geq 2$, where $\mathcal{O}^{*}$ is the Pareto Optimal front. Then, for any preference-free algorithm, there exists a subset of users with distinct preferences such that the regret $R(T) = \Omega(T)$.

results.notes: Applies to the class of preference-free algorithms (policy independent of preferences), not all algorithms.

bound.expression_latex: DRN \sqrt{ \omega T \log^{2} ((1 + \omega T/\lambda)/\vartheta)} + \frac{DRN}{\sqrt{\lambda}} \sqrt{ \omega DK T \log^2 ((1 + \omega T/\lambda)/\vartheta)} + N\sqrt{ KT \log ( T/\vartheta)} + MN

symbols.omega: weight threshold parameter of the WLS estimator
symbols.M_burn: M = floor(min{t' : t*sigma_r_down^2 + lam >= 2 D omega sqrt(K t log(t/alpha)) for all t >= t'}), a T-independent constant

conditions: rewards in [0,1] with per-coordinate variance in [sigma_r_down^2, sigma_r_up^2], sigma_r_down^2 > 0
tuning: beta_t = sqrt(omega D log((1+omega T/lambda)/alpha)) + sqrt(lambda)

source.label: theorem:up_bd_hiden
source.quote: For PAMO-MAB with hidden preference, for any $\lambda > 0$, by setting $\alpha = \sqrt{\frac{12 \vartheta}{KD(D+3) \pi^2}}$, $\omega \geq D$, $\beta_t = ...$, with probability greater than $1- 2\vartheta$, Algorithm 1 has R(T) = O(DRN \sqrt{ \omega T \log^{2} (...)} + ... + N\sqrt{ KT \log ( T/\vartheta)} + MN)

results.notes: Holds w.p. >= 1-2*vartheta. Regret defined via means. Remark 1 states ~O(D sqrt(T)) asymptotically.

symbols.alpha_conf: confidence parameter alpha of the algorithm
symbols.eta_down: eta_i^{n down}: min preference-weighted gap of arm i for user n over rounds where it is suboptimal
symbols.eta_up: eta_i^{n up}: max preference-weighted gap of arm i for user n
symbols.Delta_up: ||Delta_i^{n up}||_2: max Euclidean distance between mean reward of arm i and other available arms

source.label: theorem:up_bd_stat
source.quote: Algorithm \ref{alg:PRUCB_UP} has the regret R(T) of O( \sum_{n \in [N]} \sum_{i \in [K]} ( \frac{\delta^2 \log T}{\eta_{i}^{n \downarrow}} + D \pi^2 \alpha^2 \eta_{i}^{n \uparrow} + \frac{ D^2 \Vert \Delta_{i}^{n \uparrow} \Vert_2^2 \delta^2 }{ \eta_{i}^{n \downarrow} } ))

results.notes: Proof bounds expected pull counts, so expectation of mean-based regret. Remark 2 summarizes as O(KN delta log T + KN delta D^2).

symbols.eta_down: min preference-weighted gap of arm i when suboptimal
symbols.eta_up: max preference-weighted gap of arm i when suboptimal

conditions: mean preference given before decision making

source.quote: Assume $\overline{\boldsymbol{c}}$ is given before decision making, Algorithm \ref{alg:PRUCB_KP} has R(T) = O( \sum_{i \neq a^{*}} ( \frac{\delta^2 \eta_{i}^{\uparrow} \log T}{{\eta_{i}^{\downarrow}}^2} + D \pi^2 \alpha^2 \eta_{i}^{\uparrow} )).
